column1: Stamp duty To Commissioner of Stamp Duties, Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS) You can use IRAS' Stamp Duty Calculator to compute the stamp duty payable.
column2: For Option to Purchase (Based on selling price or market valuation, whichever is higher) First $180,000: 1% Next $180,000: 2% Next $640,000: 3% Next $500,000: 4% Remaining Amount: 5% For mortgage (Based on loan amount) 0.40% of the loan granted, subject to a maximum of $500 Note: The stamp duty will be collected by the solicitor who is acting for purchaser or mortgagor.
